results.answer:

results.question: How has Rishi Sunak influenced the United Kingdom's government and policies?
results.answer:
Rishi Sunak, upon becoming the leader of the Conservative Party and prime minister of the United Kingdom in October 2022, has had a notable impact on the UK government and its policies.

As Chancellor of the Exchequer (2020–22), Sunak faced immediate challenges from the COVID-19 pandemic. He instituted a broad economic-support program, allocating approximately £330 billion in emergency funds for businesses and salary subsidies. His "Eat Out to Help Out" scheme aimed to support restaurants and pubs.

Sunak's tenure was also marked by controversy, including scrutiny of his wife's tax status and his own U.S. residency green card. He resigned as prime minister in July 2024 and was replaced by Labour Party leader Keir Starmer after Labour won a landslide victory in a general election.

results.question: Who is Rishi Sunak?
results.answer:
Rishi Sunak, born on May 12, 1980, is a British politician and financier. In October 2022, he became the leader of the Conservative Party and prime minister of the United Kingdom. Sunak resigned as prime minister in July 2024, after the Labour Party won a landslide victory in a general election, and was replaced by Labour Party leader Keir Starmer.

Sunak's family has immigrant roots from Punjab, India, to East Africa. He attended Winchester College and studied at Oxford and Stanford Universities. Before entering politics, Sunak worked for Goldman Sachs and later in hedge funds.

Sunak was elected to the House of Commons in 2015. He became Chancellor of the Exchequer in 2020. During the COVID-19 pandemic, he implemented economic support programs. Sunak resigned from the cabinet in July 2022 and later that year became prime minister. In November 2023, he brought back David Cameron as foreign secretary. In May 2024, Sunak called a general election for July, which resulted in a Conservative defeat.
